title: Opening a bank account abroad
objectives: Explain why you are visiting the bank
Confirm your documents and ask about online banking
Ask how to make a payment while waiting

courseTemplate.setting: The student has a passport, enrolment letter and proof of address. App activation takes about five days.

stages.title: Explain why you are visiting the bank
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Good afternoon. How can I help?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain why you are visiting the bank in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'm an international student. …”

stages.title: Confirm your documents and ask about online banking
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “We'll need your passport, enrolment letter and proof of address.”
successCriteria: The learner can confirm your documents and ask about online banking in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I have all three. …”

stages.title: Ask how to make a payment while waiting
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “The activation code should arrive in about five days.”

languageNotes: 国外 "bank card" 泛指，日常消费用 debit card（储蓄卡），credit card 是信贷，别混；「流水」是 bank statement，不是 "water flow"。

warmup.prompt: Say this in English. 我想开一个活期账户。
warmup.suggestedAnswer: I'd like to open a current account.

modelDialogue.text: Good afternoon. How can I help?
I'm an international student. I'd like to open a bank account.
We'll need your passport, enrolment letter and proof of address.
I have all three. Can I set up online banking as well?
The activation code should arrive in about five days.
How can I make a bank transfer before the code arrives?
